user.title: Kurir parcel tracking
user.description: Choose your country. Flash Express and Shopee Express (SPX) work without an account. An optional free eTrackings key adds J&T, Kerry, Thailand Post and others, and is used as a fallback when Flash Express blocks automated requests.

error.etrackings_incomplete: Enter both the eTrackings API key and the key secret, or leave both empty.

init.title: Kurir options

data.keep_delivered_days: Keep delivered parcels for (days, 0 = keep until removed)
data.etrackings_monthly_limit: Maximum eTrackings requests per quota period
data.etrackings_reset_day: Day of the month your eTrackings quota renews

data_description.etrackings_monthly_limit: Kurir stops using eTrackings at this number. Keep it a little below your plan (free plan: 50) if you use the key elsewhere too.
data_description.etrackings_reset_day: eTrackings renews the quota on the day your account was created, not on the 1st. The renewal date is shown on etrackings.com next to your usage.

init.description: Optional free eTrackings key (etrackings.com → Settings → API Keys): adds J&T, Kerry, Thailand Post and others, and is the fallback when Flash Express blocks automated requests.

error.etrackings_incomplete: Enter both the eTrackings API key and the key secret, or leave both empty.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The courier tracking number, e.g. SPXTH... or TH....

name.name: Name
name.description: What is in the parcel, shown on the card.

carrier.name: Courier
carrier.description: Only needed when Kurir cannot tell the courier from the number.

add_from_text.name: Add parcels from text
add_from_text.description: Find tracking numbers in any text (an e-mail, a push notification) and track them.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text that contains one or more tracking numbers.

set_etrackings_usage.name: Set eTrackings usage
set_etrackings_usage.description: Set how many eTrackings requests are already used in the current quota period, e.g. by another tool with the same key. The number is reset automatically when the quota renews.

used.name: Requests used
used.description: Requests used so far in this quota period, as shown on etrackings.com.
